## 🔑 Legend

|Symbol         |Meaning                                                                               |
|---------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|⭐              |High-priority upstream data broker — removing here trickles down to many smaller sites|
|📧              |Email confirmation or email-only submission required                                  |
|📠              |Fax submission required                                                               |
|⚠️              |No direct opt-out available                                                           |
|On-site removal|Removal link is embedded on the profile/results page itself                           |
